crossRefs.note: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”
translations.bsb: “Why did you bring this trouble upon me?” Israel asked. “Why did you tell the man you had another brother?”
translations.kjv: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
translations.asv: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
